reason: A DSH configuration management utility for backing up, restoring, migrating, synchronizing, and selectively installing complete workspace configurations.

summaries.zh: 用于备份、恢复、迁移和同步 DeepSeek Harness 设置、插件、MCP 服务、技能及工作区配置的配置管理插件。
summaries.en: A configuration management plugin for backing up, restoring, migrating, and synchronizing DeepSeek Harness settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, and workspaces.

capabilities: Reads and packages DSH settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, profiles, agent presets, and workspace configuration
Writes imported configuration and can restore or roll back DSH state
Creates ZIP backups and optionally encrypts backup contents
Synchronizes configuration through Git repositories or WebDAV
Installs plugins and other configuration components during approved imports
Connects to GitHub for marketplace listing management
